title: A Novel Sensitive and Stretchable TPU/MXene Film-Based Strain Sensor
content: The emergence of embodiment intelligence raises an immediate demand for high-performance strain sensors with adjustable large working ranges to enable precise deformation measurements. Herein, a high-performance strain sensor based on TPU/MXene composite films is fabricated via an ultrasonic anchoring strategy, and its sensing mechanism is investigated based on the piezoresistive effect. Benefiting from the synergistic sensing effect of the embedded conductive network constructed by ultrasonic anchoring and the reversible sliding behavior of surface conductive units, the proposed sensor successfully overcomes the narrow strain range limitation of conventional MXene-based strain sensors. The resulting TPU/MXene sensor delivers an ultra-wide sensing range of 0-330 % with a maximum gauge factor of 196.4. In the low-strain region (0-100 %), it exhibits reliable linearity (R² ≈ 0.99), and its signal output remains stable after 1000 tensile cycles. Besides, the optimized TPU/MXene sensor is demonstrated for bending‑deformation measurement on a silicone rod under different cyclic bending angles. This work provides a feasible preparation strategy for high-stretchability and high-sensitivity MXene-based flexible strain sensors, and shows great application potential in flexible deformation monitoring.
